text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since the days of sprinting
through the Twinkle Series alongside her
came to a temporary close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre traveled overseas and had been
spending leisurely days, when one day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Win Variation dropped the magazine she was holding.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh...... Ah! I-I'm sorry!
Um— Orfe-san was in this magazine, and...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...We were talking about us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What Win Variation was reading was a specialized racing magazine, featuring an exclusive interview with Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —So, in that interview...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Win Variation place her trust in her Trainer
and grow from it became the clue to finding my own path"... it says.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sounds like she felt that way during her time in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um... it seems like from the start,
she never thought she needed anyone's help
to win races.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still, whether it's hitting the overseas wall... or growing even more than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thinking from there about what I was lacking...
I thought maybe it was a relationship of trust, like the one between me and Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "I started thinking... racing is something you face together with someone you trust."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That's why she said that this time, she wants to take on
the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' alongside staff she can trust—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I... I was writing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-It's totally shocking, right?!
I... didn't know anything about it either.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Just like at the Arima Kinen, Orfe-san really never says things straight, does she?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even though you don't say anything...
it feels like you're watching surprisingly closely.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To think my trust in Trainer-san
was written all over my face and totally obvious...
I-It's so embarrassing...
choice_data_list: ...Did you really trust me that much?
...Did you really trust me that much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasn't until reaching the Senior Class that I was truly able to connect with Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I thought about that, it wouldn't have been strange if we'd come this far without fully trusting each other, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Especially... after we promised to run together again,
my heart felt... so much lighter.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I can focus on training now, and races aren't nearly as scary anymore.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I shouldn't show any weakness,
but you just accepted it so naturally, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Because you told me that
my dream is your dream too."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I realized I wasn't alone.
...And so."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He hadn't been able to fully support her up until a point,
but in the end, it seemed he had truly
become a proper "Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. It's kinda embarrassing
to talk about this so formally, huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Um, since I'm already embarrassing myself, would it be okay
if I brought up one more serious topic?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...T-To be honest, I still really can't believe
that I've actually surpassed Orfe-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I won, and got even more cheers than him.
I definitely became the star.
That much is true, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Maybe the version of her in my head is just too idealized."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Strangely enough, it doesn't feel like I've surpassed it. S-So, I want to keep doing my best from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I want to work harder and harder, to become a leading star
who surpasses even the one I've always looked up to...!
So, um, that's why, uh—
choice_data_list: Yeah, I look forward to continuing to work with you.
Yeah, I'll be counting on you from now on, too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., aren't you sick of this?
Like, 'How long are you gonna keep whining about it?'...
choice_data_list: There's no way I'd be exasperated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just how dazzling she believes the leading role to be, and just how desperately she longs to become that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After these past few years,
I believe I understand quite well.
choice_data_list: Let me have the best seat in the house for the second act as well
For the second act as well, please let me have the best seat in the house

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next time, in a special prime seat,
on the greatest stage where the protagonist shines,
something she herself can be truly proud of.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... haha!
...I see. So you actually remembered our promise.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Then, I'll do it next time too! I'll try hard, work hard, and do my super-duper best!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hard work is...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Hard work will always pay off in the end!
